Quick overview

Notable patterns  
- All names follow the fixed triple-segment pattern AGS_<AREA>_<ROLE>_SRV (or _MON, _DOC, _DATA …).  
- “_SRV” suffix dominates (≈ 80 %); the rest end in _MON, _DOC, _DATA, _INFO, etc.  
- No version numbers or underscores beyond the third segment—easy to regex or auto-filter.
